reproduction: The Host wrote relay state to C:\EPT\pi-flare\agent\pi-bansos-relay-state.json while PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR pointed at that directory.
observation: Guest Pi created a session and attempted the model request, but the Host relay log contained only its startup event; the Guest output reported 502 upstream error and no relay request was recorded.
expected: pi-bansos should load the enabled relay state before its provider proxy sends catalog/model requests.
cause: The extension resolves relay state from the Guest user home .pi\agent path by homedir(), independently of PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR.
impact: The request bypassed the intended allowlisted Host egress and failed at the isolated Guest boundary; this run cannot prove relay behavior.
minimal_change: Resolve USERPROFILE through the Guest session and write relay state to <USERPROFILE>\.pi\agent\pi-bansos-relay-state.json.
rollback: Remove the per-run relay state file from the Guest user home and omit RelayUrl.
verification: New RUN_ID, Guest state-file existence check, relay log request entry, and harvested Pi session/output.
unresolved_risk: The upstream model catalog and model endpoint may still reject or change independently of the transport path.
